decisions.D01: Default unspecified nontoggle fills to 0; finite explicit selection, no cross product.
decisions.D02: Participants uses group FILL 0 closed/list and FILL 1 open; recommendation applying engaged treatment to a panel invoker.
decisions.D03: Sharing uses present_to_all FILL 0 idle, cancel_presentation FILL 1 stop, present_to_all FILL 1 for presenting badge; last choice recommended.
decisions.D04: Pin uses keep FILL 0 action, keep_off FILL 0 unpin action, keep FILL 1 pinned badge; distinct menu/status contexts justify second keep fill.
decisions.D05: Apply F00 toggle rule to lock: lock FILL 1 on, lock_open FILL 0 off; reuse in badges/rows.
decisions.D06: Warning/error FILL 1; info FILL 0; one per severity, decorative next to copy.
decisions.D07: autoMirror true for arrow_back and send, false for all other selected artwork; no caller double-mirroring.
decisions.D08: F00 common-control mappings and sentence-case accessibility labels prevail over feature snippets; retain explicit distinct badge/menu SF variants only.
decisions.D09: Extra SF literals pin.fill, mic.slash, video.slash, rectangle.inset.filled.on.rectangle are required by contexts but not availability-verified by the preflight 46-symbol inventory.
decisions.D10: Gallery only after feedback/panel acceptance; bind to its accepted coordinator after re-reading the final API. Adaptive inspector/stage retention is a separate next slice.

accessibility.owner: native localized UI strings; artwork never stores labels
accessibility.standalone_meaningful_image: must supply explicit localized semantic copy at call site; no icon-key fallback
accessibility.share_control: Stable Share screen label with Sharing value for toggle. Separate Stop sharing action keeps Stop sharing label; no global label tied to cancel_presentation artwork.
accessibility.status: merge with row/tile/copy; no separate focus target or implicit control
accessibility.disabled_or_busy: preserve label, expose enabled/busy on owner; busy spinner does not become an extra artwork entry
accessibility.context_labels: More options for {name}, Close {title}, Back to call, Clear search, Admit {name}, Host controls etc belong to explicit consumers, not renamed core assets
accessibility.roles: Roles describe use, not artwork. Host-menu Lock is Checkbox (S50:908); Switch rows keep Switch. Route rows are RadioButton with route label and selected state; route invoker is Button. Status badges never acquire an action from a reused glyph.
accessibility.state_only_style: Pressed, focused, disabled, unavailable, loading and unread/attention/count overlays reuse the same artwork; no new fill is implied. Native enabled/busy/selection/tooltip semantics belong to the owner.

history.metadata: Fresh mutable snapshot; not the historical metadata and not the SVG commit. Font codepoint differences do not rename SVGs.
